title: Frontend FPGA Board
detail: Test frame V4 · board 14 layers V14 · edited 20 Nov 2026, 16:26 CST · 16 header pins
summary: Frontend FPGA Board in its break-off test frame. The board sits in a routed cut-out held by tabs; short traces cross the tabs to the box header on the frame, whose pin names are printed beside the pins. Power the board and probe it here, then break it out; its own test pads stay usable afterwards. The frame is also the JLC assembly panel.

pins.label: 3V3 OUT
pins.fn: 3.3 V OUTPUT of the 5 V to 3.3 V converter U16 (the rail that also feeds the FPGA-LDO A board through J2.68-70): measure here; do not feed while 5 V is applied

pins.label: 3V3 OUT
pins.fn: 3.3 V OUTPUT of the 5 V to 3.3 V converter U16 (the rail that also feeds the FPGA-LDO A board through J2.68-70): measure here; do not feed while 5 V is applied

pins.label: RAILPG
pins.fn: All boot rails good (high when the boot rails are up)

pins.label: INIT_B
pins.fn: FPGA INIT_B (configuration init / CRC error, open drain)

pins.label: VCCO
pins.fn: ASIC bank rail VCCO 1.5 V (U4), monitor only

pins.label: 5V IN
pins.fn: 5 V INPUT: bench supply in, return on pin 16 (GND). It feeds U16, which makes VIN_3V3; in the head this 5 V arrives on the cable, J3.19
